note: Belize Bank, which says it is the only bank in Belize offering a variety of credit cards, read on 2026-11-03: its personal credit card FAQ (question 09) gives the rate as 22% annually, the period its rates page (blank-24) left unstated, and that page gives 22% and a minimum payment of 3% of the outstanding balance, at least BZ$50, for all three personal cards. Its Schedule of Fees (the PDF behind its flipbook, made 18 September 2026; pages 2 and 3, read from their images) gives each card's yearly membership fee for the main holder (BZ$170, BZ$130 and BZ$190; the FAQ's figures agree, the rates page's older BZ$120 and BZ$160 aren't used), BZ$60 late and BZ$50 over the limit each statement cycle, a cash advance fee of 2.5% with a floor of BZ$10, and a foreign exchange fee of 0.875% on international transactions, written as fx. The schedule's 1.75% government stamp duty on international transactions isn't written: its footnote limits the duty to payments over US$50 without marking which rows it governs, and the rates page writes the duty as 0.0175%, so how much is charged on what isn't certain. Interest charged on a statement paid in full by its due date is reversed the next month, but no number of days is stated, so no grace period is written. The cards are billed in Belize dollars. Heritage Bank and Atlantic Bank publish no card terms (earlier rounds).

sources.title: Belize Bank, Personal Credit Cards FAQs
sources.said: 01 What types of personal credit card products do you offer? We offer three types of personal credit cards from which you can choose. These are: 1. Mastercard Platinum 2. AAdvantage® Mastercard Standard 3. AAdvantage® Mastercard Platinum ... 09 What is the interest rate charged on credit cards? Our interest rates are competitive with those on the local market at 22% annually. Interest is calculated on the average daily balance on your account. ... If the full payment is made on or before the due date shown on the credit card statement, the interest will be discounted. (The interest is shown on the statement, but it is reversed the following month.) 10 What is the membership fee on personal credit cards? Credit card annual fees are as follows: • Mastercard Standard Personal – $130 BZD for the main cardholder ... • Mastercard Standard Personal – AA – $170 BZD for the main cardholder ... • Mastercard Platinum Personal – AA – $190 BZD for the main cardholder ... Going over your limit will result in a fee of $50BZD or $25USD. ... Your credit card late fee is $60BZD or $30USD.
